name: pg_strings_conversion_similar_regexes
subject: Fix conversion of SIMILAR TO regexes for character classes
goal:
Conversion of SIMILAR TO patterns into POSIX regular expressions incorrectly escapes or reinterprets metacharacters that occur inside bracket character classes.

Exercise classes containing `_`, `%`, `.`, `$`, `(`, `^`, leading `]`, doubled carets and POSIX classes such as `[:alpha:]`. Within a bracket class, characters that SQL defines literally must remain literal; wildcard expansion and escaping outside the class must still occur, and syntactically unbalanced expressions must still error. EXPLAIN's emitted regex and actual matches must agree for all these cases.
